title: Delta-neutral funding-carry feasibility study (RE-DISPATCH declaration)
status: Frozen before any PnL computation. The original RD-009 crew claimed scope in issue #35 comment 6890890087 but died (sandbox download failures) before fetching data or running anything; no cell was ever executed under that claim. This declaration freezes the cells for the re-dispatched run and is posted on issue #35 with its SHA-256 before the runner executes.
question: Does a delta-neutral cash-and-carry book on Binance USDT-M perpetuals (long spot vs short perp; reverse where funding is negative) harvest funding net of realistic costs, out-of-sample, on the standard walk-forward folds?
boundary_vs_rd003: RD-003's funding_extremes family was a DIRECTIONAL perp signal judged price-only, with funding cashflows explicitly NOT modelled (rd3/families_rd3.py: 'price-only judgement (funding cashflows are NOT ...)'). RD-009 models the funding cashflows themselves with price exposure hedged coin-quantity-neutral. Different mechanism; RD-003's cells are not re-judged.

universe.activation_rule: A symbol is active in a fold only if funding, perp and spot series all cover that fold. Uncovered symbol-folds are excluded and reported, never filled or approximated.

data.funding: Binance Vision UM fundingRate monthly archives, via the RD-003 cache (~/workspace/str-rd3/cache_funding). Every panel CSV's SHA-256 verified against Stratex/rigorous_backtest/results_rd3/funding_manifest.json before use: 30/30 match.
data.perp_prices: Binance Vision UM 1h klines via the RD-002 cache (~/workspace/str-rd2/cache2). Every CSV's SHA-256 verified against its sidecar manifest: 30/30 match. Daily close = close of the last complete 1h bar of the UTC day.
data.spot_prices: Binance Vision spot 1d klines monthly archives fetched for this task (months 2024-01..2026-10). Every zip's SHA-256 verified against its published .CHECKSUM before use; canonical CSV + per-symbol sidecar; merged manifest ships in results_rd9/spot_manifest.json. Absent months (404) recorded, never filled.

folds.rule: Headline metrics use ONLY episodes entered inside folds. Episodes are force-exited at fold end and attributed to the fold of entry.

mechanics.decision_grid: Daily at 00:00 UTC. Signal F72(t) = sum of funding prints with timestamps in (t-72h, t], expressed in % of notional. Uses only prints at or before t (causal).
mechanics.execution_prices: Entry/exit at the daily close of day t-1 (the price at decision time t) for both legs.
mechanics.funding_window: An episode entered at t_e and exited at t_x earns the prints with timestamps in (t_e, t_x].
mechanics.hedge: Coin-quantity hedge fixed at entry (q units spot vs q units perp). No rebalance trades occur by construction; margin drift is reported as an operational caveat, not modelled as PnL.
mechanics.funding_notional: Each print's cashflow uses P_print = close of the perp 1h bar ending at the print timestamp (declared approximation of the settlement mark price).
mechanics.episode_pnl_pct_of_entry_spot_notional: dir * ( ((S_exit - S_entry) - (P_exit - P_entry)) / S_entry + SUM_{prints in (t_e,t_x]} rate * P_print / S_entry ) * 100 - fees_pct - slippage_pct - borrow_pct
mechanics.borrow: NEG direction only: 0.02% of notional per day held (declared assumption; archive data cannot observe real margin borrow rates, so NEG results are upper bounds).

costs.2x: Fees, slippage and borrow all doubled (sensitivity run for every cell).

cells.rule: Hold POS carry (long spot / short perp) for every active symbol for the whole fold; one episode per symbol per fold.
Hold NEG carry (short spot / long perp) likewise; borrow charged.

cells.exit: F72 < theta/3, or 45 days held, or fold end

F72 > -theta/3, or 45 days held, or fold end

bar: A cell PASSES only if ALL of RD-002's checks hold, with episodes in place of trades: expectancy > 0; PF >= 1.2; >= 200 OOS episodes; >= 80% of folds positive (4/5, fold PnL summed over its episodes); holdout (W5) expectancy > 0; breadth >= 50% of episode-bearing symbols net positive; 2x-cost expectancy > 0; Bonferroni: one-sided t-test p on episode PnLs < 0.05/1934. A cell failing any check is a FAIL; near-misses are reported as texture, never promoted.
known_limitations_declared_upfront: Episode PnLs share calendar days across symbols (cross-correlated), so t-test p-values are optimistic; the Bonferroni threshold at the global counter is the guard, and the feasibility verdict does not rest on p-values alone.

Always-on cells produce at most 150 episodes (30 symbols x 5 folds) and therefore cannot meet the 200-episode check; their bar outcome is reported as declared, and the feasibility verdict for the always-on book rests on the descriptive evidence (net yield, drawdown, decomposition) labelled as such.
NEG-direction borrow cost is a declared assumption (0.02%/day), not observed data; NEG results are upper bounds. Spot borrow availability in size is not observable from archives.
Funding settlement uses the 1h-close approximation for the mark price at each print.
descriptive_not_trials: Per-symbol always-on POS and NEG net carry: gross funding, basis component, costs, net, annualised net yield on one-leg notional.

always_pos pooled equity curve (continuous book over the whole OOS era, equal-weight across active symbols, daily marked: funding accrued at prints, basis marked at daily closes, entry costs once, exit costs at era end) with max drawdown; same for always_neg.

Failure-mode census: worst episodes decomposed (funding vs basis vs costs); negative-print share per symbol in the OOS era; longest negative-funding streaks; worst 1-day basis moves; max adverse perp excursion during episodes (1h highs/lows vs entry) as liquidation-distance evidence at 1x and at the owner's 3x pin.
Forward-test specification: what a paper simulation on demo-fapi would need (duration, logging fields, kill criteria) before any governed deployment could be proposed.
sanity_checks: S1: synthetic zero-cost frozen-price input => episode PnL equals the sum of funding prints exactly.
S2: for every real episode, funding + basis - costs == total PnL (decomposition identity, tolerance 1e-9).
S3: BTC always_pos W1 funding component recomputed by an independent summation path and compared.
prohibitions: Research only: no orders placed anywhere, no production code, registry or daemon changes, live trading prohibited. Paper simulation only, on historical archives.
